rows.description: A high-performance backend cache system.  It is intended for use in speeding up dynamic web applications by alleviating database load.  Well implemented, it can drops the database load to almost nothing, yielding faster page load times for users, better resource utilization.  It is simple yet powerful.
Explore, document and optimize any database

One browser tab for PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server, MongoDB, Redis, SQLite, Couchbase, ClickHouse, Druid, DuckDB, Turso and more. An open-source SQL IDE with SSO, audit trail and AI-assisted queries MIT licensed, with nothing held back behind an enterprise wall.
